old_caption:
The video showcases a mesmerizing domino effect sequence set on a wooden floor. At the center of the scene is a circular arrangement of dominos, meticulously arranged in a vibrant rainbow pattern. The colors transition smoothly from blue at the outer edge to red at the inner core, creating a visually striking spiral effect. Surrounding this central circle are additional rows of dominos, also in various colors, forming concentric rings.

To the left of the main circular arrangement, there is a smaller, incomplete structure made of dominos, suggesting an ongoing or interrupted construction process. This structure appears to be part of a larger design, possibly a bridge or another geometric formation, which is partially visible and incomplete.

As the video progresses, the camera remains stationary, focusing on the intricate details of the domino setup. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the vivid colors and the precision of the arrangement. The wooden floor provides a neutral background that contrasts beautifully with the bright dominos, enhancing their visual appeal. The video captures the static, prepared state of the domino setup before any falling begins.

caption: The video showcases a static top-down view of a wooden floor, where a large multi-colored spiral of dominoes fills the center, blue and green outside, yellow and orange next, red and pink inside. White domino runs frame the scene: a long straight row across the top, a zigzag at the upper left, and an L-shaped run on the left whose vertical arm ends near a small wooden block, a gap separating it from the spiral's outer end. As the clip unfolds, the vertical arm of the left L-shaped run tilts and lies down. Starting at the outer-left end of the spiral, a falling wave propagates along the outer ring toward the top, leaving a growing arc of blue-topped dominoes flat at the upper left while the rest of the ring stands. A blue domino lies just outside the spiral's outer outline at the upper left, a spot empty at the start. The inner rings of the spiral stay standing. The long top white row and the upper-left zigzag remain unchanged. The collapse is still in progress at the end, with only the outer-left arc down and most of the spiral upright. Camera stays fixed.
